source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Introduction to Predicate Logic (PDF 31, printed 27).

blocks.text: Predicate logic aise statements parhti hai jin mein variables aur predicates hon. Predicate aisa statement hai jo variables ki values ke mutabiq sach ya jhoot ho sakta hai. Maslan “x 5 se bara hai” predicate hai, kyunke is ka sach ya jhoot hona x par depend karta hai. Predicate logic se “Tamam students mehnati hain” ya “Kuch kitabein dilchasp hain” jaise statements likhe ja sakte hain. Yeh knowledge (ilm) ko formal (baqaida) tareeqe se likhne ke liye istemal hoti hai.

items: Predicate: variable ki value ke mutabiq sach ya jhoot (“x 5 se bara hai”).
Predicate logic “Tamam” aur “Kuch” wale statements likh sakti hai.
